summary: GRN Fase 0 (prasyarat penerimaan) tested end-to-end. Ran /app/backend/tests/test_grn_phase0.py → 12/12 PASS covering: (0.1) POST /wms/tasks/{id}/advance rejects inbound with 409 USE_RECEIVING_FLOW for qc_check and put_away, non-inbound unchanged; (0.2) receiving.block_over_remaining toggled via PUT /config/values changes scan-label OVER_PO behaviour; (0.3) receiving.line_qty_tolerance_pct exposed via uom-options and enforced in complete() (pct=2 and pct=5); (0.4) domain_registry.require_grade maps A+→A, C→BS, blank falls back, unknown raises; scan-receive rejects 'Z' with 'Grade Z tidak dikenal' and maps A+→A stored; (0.6) over-receipt override — warehouse still 400, admin without reason 400, admin with reason 200 and over_override_reason stored; (0.7) uq_supplier_sku index present and duplicate insert raises DuplicateKeyError, lookup filters status=active; (0.8) po_line_guard.duplicate_line_message + POST /purchase-orders/{id}/amend rejects duplicate product line with 'lebih dari satu baris PO'. Manual: scripts/check_supplier_item_duplicates.py returns 'OK — tidak ada duplikat', exit 0 (when env vars sourced). Frontend smoke: login admin → ?view=operations&entity=ent_ksc renders WMS Operations with Barang Masuk tab visible; no page errors. Code review confirmed in-scope grade dropdowns use useDomainEnums (InboundScanForm scan-grade-select, ScannedRollRow, GRCatchWeightModal, MakloonOrderDetailPanel mko-recv-roll-grade-*, SupplierItemFormModal), GRCatchWeightModal receives tolPct from uom.options.line_qty_tolerance_pct, ScannerTaskPanel disables advance-wms-task-button for flow_type=='inbound', MobileTaskActions qty starts empty with placeholder 'Hitung fisik (unit)' and 'waiting_goods' included in eligible statuses, InboundTaskPanel exposes scan-task-override-{taskId} + askReason retry, inbound_scan_label reads block_over_remaining/label_variance_tolerance_percent/auto_rfid_on_scan via services.config_resolver.value_of. Regression suites test_fase_sl_* fail across the board because they hardcode task wms_e2e3d9059660 / KSC/PO-00014 that no longer exists in current seed (explicitly flagged as non-regression in the review request); makloon partial-queue suite: all 6 SKIPPED (seed missing).

minor.issue: Script reads os.environ['MONGO_URL'] directly without load_dotenv → fails with KeyError unless the shell sources /app/backend/.env first. Add `from dotenv import load_dotenv; load_dotenv('/app/backend/.env')` so admins can run it plainly per its own docstring.

action_items: (Optional, out of Fase 0 scope) Two frontend files still hardcode grade lists but were NOT in the spec: /app/frontend/src/features/wms/warehouses/WarehouseProfileDrawer.jsx (const GRADES = ['A','B','C','BS']) and /app/frontend/src/features/purchasing/ReturnDetailPanel.jsx (const GRADES = ['A','B','C']). Consider migrating both to useDomainEnums in a follow-up so the SSOT is truly the only source (KN-A1 style).
(Optional) Add load_dotenv to scripts/check_supplier_item_duplicates.py so it works standalone as its docstring advertises.
critical_code_review_comments: Grade SSOT enforcement is correct for the phase-0 code paths (scan-receive, complete, confirm-measure, makloon receive rolls). Two out-of-scope UIs (WarehouseProfileDrawer, ReturnDetailPanel) still hardcode grades; they don't affect receiving flows but are drift risk for future phases.

advance-wms-task-button disable relies solely on selectedTask?.flow_type === 'inbound'. Server-side USE_RECEIVING_FLOW guard is the source of truth (tested), so the UI is fine, but any future flow_type value alias (e.g. 'inbound_makloon') would silently bypass the disable — consider a helper isInboundFlow(task) shared with backend router.

receiving.line_qty_tolerance_pct is fetched via GET /inbound/tasks/{id}/uom-options and used both server-side (complete roll-sum) and client-side (GRCatchWeightModal tolPct). Good symmetry; consider caching in a React hook to avoid re-request per open.
